keyLimits.en: 1 social set (8 profiles total), 1 user, 30 posts per profile per month, 5 AI credits/month, basic scheduling and link in bio.
2 social sets (16 profiles total), 2 users, 180 posts per profile per month, 50 AI credits/month, collaboration tools, social inbox, UGC collection.
6 social sets (48 profiles total), 4 users, unlimited posts, 100 AI credits/month, custom analytics, meta ads analytics, competitive benchmarking, priority support.

cautions.en: Annual billing gives 3 months free (25% savings) versus paying monthly; the annualPerMonth figures above already reflect that discount.

capabilities.en: Social media scheduling across multiple platforms with a visual content calendar and best-time-to-post suggestions.
Link in Bio tool for driving traffic from social profiles to a customizable landing page.
Social inbox and user-generated content (UGC) collection tools on Growth and above.

limitations.en: No free plan; entry Starter plan starts at $25/month (or $18.75/month annual) with a hard cap of 30 posts per profile per month.
Advanced analytics (custom analytics, meta ads analytics, competitive benchmarking) are reserved for the top Scale plan.
